beats: Kilometers of road went by with nothing to say — real history sat just out of reach.
The places the app already knew were too far off to ever surface it.
Now it checks DigitaltMuseum's archive — old photographs, museum records — for anything near the track.
A find near a known place joins its story. A find with nothing nearby becomes a brand-new stop, named after the farm it came from.
The reach: 150 meters off the road.
